summary: BUG-0173: Hold concurrent master probe leases on one shared open description so closing one lease cannot release another on SMB. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal probe-lease handling only; operator workflow, validation, permissions and recovery are unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. The Core peer lock POST/DELETE, challenge modes, authentication, lease bound and member access reports keep their schemas and failure behavior; a duplicate held range is refused with the existing conflict response.

roadmap.reason: Current network storage reliability scope only.

state.reason: Probe leases remain process-local and ten-second bounded. No durable setting is added; Core master storage registrations and existing inventory/adoption remain authoritative.

verification.method: Native SMB controls on the disposable three-Core lab: two open descriptions lost range B when A closed; one description kept B after A was released (20/20). Regression test fails on the per-lease-descriptor code and passes with the fix; agent normal/race suites passed. Clean native deployment and SMB health observation are recorded in the QA follow-up.
